The search turned up the FY2026 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2026) and several secondary write-ups. The main finding is that one material weakness remains open.

- **Remaining weakness:** The 10-K says the company's information technology controls for certain financial-reporting systems did not operate for a sufficient period, and it concludes that internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of June 30, 2026 (The 10-K's Item 9A text describes an IT controls weakness for systems supporting financial reporting). Coverage describes the open issue as IT user access and program monitoring (the company continues to report a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting specifically regarding IT user access and program monitoring).
- **Prior weaknesses:** The filing says the three weaknesses reported in the FY2025 10-K were addressed through new and redesigned controls during FY2026 (the company successfully implemented new controls and processes, and enhanced and redesigned certain controls and procedures). One news summary agrees that three previously identified material weaknesses have been resolved, while one information technology general control weakness remains.
- **Filing date:** Sources disagree on the date. One says the 10-K was filed with the SEC on Aug 31, 2026, while a news item refers to the company's SEC filing on June 30th, which is likely the fiscal year-end date rather than the filing date. The filing itself is the more reliable source for the date.
- **Context:** Management still concluded the consolidated financial statements fairly present the company's financial position in all material respects. The company also cautioned that the weaknesses could affect its ability to report accurately and on time (the weaknesses could affect its ability to report results on time and accurately).

I did not open the full 10-K, so details of the remediation timeline are unconfirmed. The primary source is https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm.

Can SMCI even be trusted?","url":"https://en.bulios.com/status/270835-record-breaking-contracts-criminal-charges-and-an-auditor-who-resigned-can-smci-even-be-trusted"},{"title":"• Live Feeds","url":"https://quantisnow.com/insight/supermicro-announces-completion-of-review-by-independent-special-committee-5795459"},{"title":"• Live Feeds","url":"https://qnow.quantisnow.com/insight/supermicro-announces-completion-of-review-by-independent-special-committee-5795459"}]

Super Micro's auditor history is clear, but the search turned up no 2026 restatement or auditor change. The 2026 news is mainly about export-control criminal charges and a class action.

- **Auditor:** Ernst & Young resigned in October 2024, telling the board it could no longer rely on management's representations. Its auditor was replaced with BDO. BDO remains the auditor of record, according to a later Benzinga piece.
- **Restatement:** In late 2024, the Special Committee largely cleared management and the board, concluding that there was no evidence of executive misconduct, no restatement was required. Critics note that no restatement does not equate to the absence of errors.
- **2026 developments:** SMCI shares fell 33% the day the indictment surfaced, and Liaw resigned from the board. Supermicro itself was not named as a defendant. A July 2026 filing said the board is conducting an independent review of transactions tied to alleged export-control violations, and that findings could affect forecasts and prior-period results. Taiwan's Keelung District Prosecutors Office opened a parallel probe.
- **Class action:** A securities class action covers purchases from 02/02/2024 - 03/19/2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of 05/26/26.
- **Nasdaq:** Full Nasdaq compliance wasn't restored until January 2026.

I did not find confirmation of the current status of the SEC investigation itself, or any 2026 announcement that prior financials must be restated. The sources are also mixed in date and some are commentary sites, so checking SEC EDGAR filings for the latest 10-K/10-Q and the company's investor relations releases would be the next step.

Links: [{"title":"Supermicro Announces Completion of Review by Independent Special Committee","url":"https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/supermicro-announces-completion-review-independent-special-committee-2024-12-02"},{"title":"Press release dated December 2, 2024","url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536524000044/pressrelease-specialcommit.htm"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Supermicro Announces Completion of Review by Independent Special Committee","url":"https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2024/Supermicro-Announces-Completion-of-Review-by-Independent-Special-Committee/default.aspx"},{"title":"Supermicro Announces Completion of Review by Independent Special Committee","url":"https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20241202905643/en/Supermicro-Announces-Completion-of-Review-by-Independent-Special-Committee"},{"title":"Super Micro's working capital is under pressure, on top of all its other troubles","url":"https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-working-capital-is-under"},{"title":"Supermicro says it found \"no evidence of fraud or misconduct,\" but will replace its CFO - DCD","url":"https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/supermicro-says-it-found-no-evidence-of-fraud-or-misconduct-but-will-replace-its-cfo/"},{"title":"Super Micro’s Export Control Issues: Compliance and Financial Reporting Implications","url":"https://natlawreview.com/article/super-micros-export-control-issues-compliance-and-financial-reporting-implications"},{"title":"Super Micro's export control issues: relationships with customers and financial reporting considerations","url":"https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-export-control-issues"},{"title":"This article is more than 1 year old","url":"https://www.theregister.com/2024/12/02/super_micro_no_misconduct/"}]

The results cover the 2024 special committee review in detail, but only partly cover the 2026 situation. I ran one search, so I found nothing on the 2026 10-K's contents, any restatement, or inventory and working-capital figures.

**2024 Special Committee review:** The committee, supported by Cooley LLP and Secretariat Advisors, found no evidence of misconduct on the part of management or the Board of Directors and that the Audit Committee acted independently. The company said the Special Committee concluded it appears the Company has implemented a reasonable program for compliance with applicable export control regulations. It also found no evidence suggesting that anyone at the Company tried to circumvent export control regulations. The review was announced with no restatement of reported financials expected.

**2026 developments:** On April 7, 2026, Super Micro announced a new independent internal investigation led by two independent board members and supported by the law firm Munger, Tolles & Olson LLP and forensic accounting consultants from AlixPartners. Per one analysis, the earlier review largely focused on concerns related to shipments potentially involving Russia, while the new investigation centers on alleged illegal re-exports of AI servers to China.

**Working capital and reporting:** One commentary says its working capital is under pressure and the disclosure leaves open questions. Another piece discusses reported Oracle order changes, inventory exposure, and revenue recognition risks, though the snippet gave no figures. Its author also argues that no restatement does not equate to the absence of errors.

For the 10-K, restatement, and inventory specifics, a follow-up search on the company's FY2026 annual report or 8-K filings would be needed.

content.text:
## 評估結果：約 60 / 100（中高風險）

這是依據二手報導與搜尋結果做的判斷，我沒有逐頁讀完 10-K 全文，所以分數的可信度有限。分數代表「FY2026 財報存在重大錯誤或需要重編的風險」的相對高低，不是機率。

## 主要風險因子（推高分數）

1. **內控仍有未解決的重大缺陷。** 報導指出，FY2026 10-K（截至 2026/6/30）認定財務報導內部控制無效，剩下的缺陷在 IT 控制，主要是 IT 使用者存取與程式監控。這類缺陷會直接削弱帳務資料的可靠性。來源：[FY2026 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm)、[StockTitan 摘要](https://stockti.com/super-micro-revenue-surges-78-but-margin-pressures-and-control-gaps-linger)

2. **出口管制調查尚未結案，且可能影響前期數字。** 2026 年 3 月有相關人員遭起訴（公司本身未被列為被告），股價當日大跌約 33%。公司於 2026 年 7 月的文件表示，獨立審查結果可能影響預測與前期結果。2026 年 4 月另由獨立董事領導的內部調查，由 Munger Tolles 與 AlixPartners 協助。若調查發現違規交易，可能牽涉收入認列、存貨減損、或有負債（ASC 450）的估計與揭露。來源：[StockTitan](https://stockti.com/super-micro-revenue-surges-78-but-margin-pressures-and-control-gaps-linger)、[TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/super-micro-smci-stock-under-pressure-after-sec-filing-reveals-material-weaknesses)

3. **審計歷史不穩。** 2024 年 10 月 Ernst & Young 辭任，表示無法再信賴管理層聲明；後由 BDO 接任。這段歷史本身就是重要的風險訊號。來源：[TweakTown](https://www.tweaktown.com/news/101426/supermicro-stock-plummets-35-after-accounting-firm-resigns-on-the-spot-doj-probe/index.html)

4. **快速成長與營運複雜度。** 營收年增約 78%，並有營運資金壓力、存貸與客戶訂單變動等議題。快速成長通常伴隨收入截止與存貨估值的錯誤風險。來源：[Deep Quarry](https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-working-capital-is-under)

5. **已通過的重編測試並不代表沒有錯誤。** 2024 年特別委員會結論為無管理層舞弊，也未要求重編；但批評者指出，「沒有重編」不等於「沒有錯誤」。

## 減分因素

- 管理層認為財務報表在所有重大方面皆公允。
- 先前的三項重大缺陷據稱已在 FY2026 補救。不過補救是否已經過足夠期間測試，仍待確認。
- 2026 年 1 月已恢復 Nasdaq 合規。

## 結論與限制

綜合來看，風險主要集中在「IT 控制未有效」加上「出口管制調查可能追溯影響前期數字」這兩點。我會給 **約 60 分**：不是說已有重大錯誤，而是說財報需要被更仔細地檢視。

我沒有讀到 10-K 全文，以下內容最可能決定分數的高低，建議優先查看：
- **Item 9A**：缺陷的具體描述與補救時程。
- **財報附註的或有負債與期後事項**：是否有出口管制相關的準備金或揭露。
- **查核報告的關鍵查核事項（CAM）**：BDO 特別點出哪些領域。
- **存貨與收入認列附註**：特別是與特定客戶和地區有關的交易。
- **最近一季 10-Q 與 8-K**：確認獨立審查的最新進度。

如果你要，我可以再派一個代理人去讀 10-K 全文的這幾個段落，把分數依實際內容校準。
